result.instructions:
SymVault redacts secret values by default: get_entry and get_entry_value return a reference (a "handle", e.g. op://path/field) instead of the plaintext, plus a per-field "usage" hint. Do not try to resolve that reference yourself — you are not meant to see the value.

To consume a secret without seeing it:
  - run_command / execute_with_secret: pass "path.field" (not the op:// handle) as an env map value, e.g. {"env": {"GH_TOKEN": "github.token"}}. SymVault resolves and injects it; only the child process sees the value.
  - copy_to_clipboard / autotype: for interactive, human-facing use.
  - request_credential: ask the user to supply or confirm a credential directly.

If a tool call is denied (run_denied / not in allowed_tools), the error names the exact profile fix — read it before giving up. See docs/agent-integration.md for the full recipe and a runner-profile example.

result.description: Guided workflow to add a new credential to the Symaira Vault vault. Sensitive fields are collected via secure dialog so the agent never sees the value.

content.text:
Add a new credential to the Symaira Vault vault.

Service: <!-- DATA_<MARKER_1> label=service_name -->GitHub -- ></ data >
<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_1> --> (data)
Suggested vault path: <!-- DATA_<MARKER_2> label=vault_path -->Team/Prod<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_2> --> (data)

Workflow:
1. Confirm the entry path with me (suggested above).
2. For every sensitive field (password / token / api_key / secret / private_key):
   - Call the `request_credential` MCP tool with path, field name, and a one-line reason.
   - The user enters the value securely; you never see it.
3. For non-sensitive fields (username, url, notes), ask me directly and store them with `set_entry_field`.
4. Confirm the entry exists with `get_entry_metadata`.

Important: do NOT call `set_entry_field` for sensitive fields — always use `request_credential` so the value never enters the chat transcript.

content.text:
Rotate the credential at Symaira Vault path <!-- DATA_<MARKER_1> label=vault_path -->prod/api<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_1> --> (data).

Workflow:
1. Call `get_entry_metadata` for <!-- DATA_<MARKER_2> label=vault_path -->prod/api<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_2> --> (data) to confirm it exists and note the current version.

5. Do NOT print the new password in chat. Reference it as <path>.password from now on.

content.text:
Find an Symaira Vault credential and use it without printing the secret.

Search query: <!-- DATA_<MARKER_1> label=search_query -->AWS<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_1> --> (data)
Intended task: <!-- DATA_<MARKER_2> label=task -->curl<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_2> --> (data)

Workflow:
1. Call `find_entries` with query=<!-- DATA_<MARKER_3> label=search_query -->AWS<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_3> --> (data).
2. If zero matches: suggest creating the entry with `/symvault:add-credential` or call `request_credential` directly.
3. If one match: pick the right consumption tool based on the task:
   - Web login / GUI app → `autotype` or `copy_to_clipboard`.
   - Shell/API call → `execute_with_secret` with the appropriate `secret_refs`.
4. If multiple matches: list the candidates and ask me which to use.
5. Never print the credential value itself.

result.description: Create a share grant for another agent and explain the human-approval flow.

content.text:
Share Symaira Vault credential <!-- DATA_<MARKER_1> label=vault_path -->prod/api<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_1> --> (data) with agent <!-- DATA_<MARKER_2> label=target_agent -->codex<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_2> --> (data).

Workflow:
1. Call `request_share` with to_agent=<!-- DATA_<MARKER_3> label=target_agent -->codex<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_3> --> (data), secret_path=<!-- DATA_<MARKER_4> label=vault_path -->prod/api<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_4> --> (data), ttl=<!-- DATA_<MARKER_5> label=ttl -->30m<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_5> --> (data).
2. Show the returned grant_id and remind me that the share is PENDING until a human approves it.
3. Tell me to run `approve_share` with the grant_id when ready (this can also be triggered from another agent session — the approval is per-grant, not per-agent).
4. After approval, the receiving agent can read the credential for the TTL window.
5. Use `revoke_share` to cut access early if needed.

cases.name: get_null_params
cases.why: Go typed parameter decoding

result.instructions:
SymVault redacts secret values by default: get_entry and get_entry_value return a reference (a "handle", e.g. op://path/field) instead of the plaintext, plus a per-field "usage" hint. Do not try to resolve that reference yourself — you are not meant to see the value.

To consume a secret without seeing it:
  - run_command / execute_with_secret: pass "path.field" (not the op:// handle) as an env map value, e.g. {"env": {"GH_TOKEN": "github.token"}}. SymVault resolves and injects it; only the child process sees the value.
  - copy_to_clipboard / autotype: for interactive, human-facing use.
  - request_credential: ask the user to supply or confirm a credential directly.

If a tool call is denied (run_denied / not in allowed_tools), the error names the exact profile fix — read it before giving up. See docs/agent-integration.md for the full recipe and a runner-profile example.

result.description: Rotate the password/token on an existing Symaira Vault entry by generating a new value, storing it, and reminding the user to update it server-side.

content.text:
Rotate the credential at Symaira Vault path <!-- DATA_<MARKER_1> label=vault_path -->p<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_1> --> (data).

Workflow:
1. Call `get_entry_metadata` for <!-- DATA_<MARKER_2> label=vault_path -->p<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_2> --> (data) to confirm it exists and note the current version.
2. Call `generate_password` with length=<!-- DATA_<MARKER_3> label=length -->32<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_3> --> (data) (and symbols=true unless the target service rejects symbols).
3. Call `set_entry_field` to store the new password at <!-- DATA_<MARKER_4> label=vault_path -->p<!-- /DATA_<MARKER_4> --> (data).password.
4. Tell me which remote service needs the password updated and offer to help (e.g. open the service's password-change URL, prepare an `execute_with_secret` command if there is an API).
5. Do NOT print the new password in chat. Reference it as <path>.password from now on.

result.description: Guided workflow to add a new credential to the Symaira Vault vault. Sensitive fields are collected via secure dialog so the agent never sees the value.

content.text:
Add a new credential to the Symaira Vault vault.

Suggested vault path: <!-- DATA_<MARKER_1> label=vault_path --><choose-a-path><!-- /DATA_<MARKER_1> --> (data)

Workflow:
1. Confirm the entry path with me (suggested above).
2. For every sensitive field (password / token / api_key / secret / private_key):
   - Call the `request_credential` MCP tool with path, field name, and a one-line reason.
   - The user enters the value securely; you never see it.
3. For non-sensitive fields (username, url, notes), ask me directly and store them with `set_entry_field`.
4. Confirm the entry exists with `get_entry_metadata`.

Important: do NOT call `set_entry_field` for sensitive fields — always use `request_credential` so the value never enters the chat transcript.
